title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - User
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/User. A health actor (patient included) that can be equiped with BANs or health devices for monitoring, control, care (specific case of patients) or support purposes (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthActor; inherits firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan and hasActivity from HealthActor (see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthActor/schema.json). Superclass of Patient, a zero-own-property candidate that inherits every property declared here (hasHabit, hasImpairment, hasChronicDisease, posture) with nothing of its own.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'User'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasHabit.description: Property. The habits of a user and a patient (as sub-class of user it also inherits habit), e.g. smoking or overeating. TS-table-confirmed property name (ETSI TS 103 410-8 Table 2: s4ehaw:hasHabit, domain User, range Habit); the Habit class and its 4 StateValue individuals ARE ttl-confirmed, but the hasHabit object-property triple itself is not found in the published saref4ehaw.ttl -- flagged provisional for the property name/IRI specifically.

hasImpairment.description: Property. The impairment type of a user and a patient (as sub-class of user it also inherits impairment), e.g. aural, skeletal, ocular, mobility, intellectual. These are non-exhaustive and compatible with the World Health Organization classification per the ttl comment. TS-table-confirmed property name (ETSI TS 103 410-8 Table 2: s4ehaw:hasImpairment, domain User, range Impairment); the Impairment class and its 5 StateValue individuals ARE ttl-confirmed, but the hasImpairment object-property triple itself is not found in the published saref4ehaw.ttl -- flagged provisional for the property name/IRI specifically.

hasChronicDisease.description: Property. For chronic disease modelling, e.g. diabetes, asthma. Non-exhaustive by design: ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.3.1's worked example additionally infers a Covid-19 ChronicDisease individual ad hoc at runtime, so implementations should treat this list as open rather than closed. Property name attested in TS clause 4.3.1 prose ('the user is automatically inferred as patient that has (s4ehaw:hasChronicDisease property) COVID-19 disease (a s4ehaw:ChronicDisease)'); the ChronicDisease class and its 2 StateValue individuals ARE ttl-confirmed, the hasChronicDisease property name is TS-prose-attested only, not a declared ttl triple -- flagged provisional.

posture.description: Property. The posture of a health actor (mainly a patient or a user), e.g. exercising, lying, running, sitting, walking. ttl-confirmed State class (s4ehaw:Posture) and its 5 StateValue individuals; undomained by any explicit OWL restriction, attached here to User per ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.2's prose, which groups Postures together with Habit/Impairment/ChronicDisease under 'Patient and User may have in particular'.
